name: Wasteland armor
notes: Origin at the neck base, face +Z, wearer's left +X. Parts collar, chest, pelvis, shoulderL, shoulderR, pipeL, pipeR (pivots at neck collar, sternum, pelvis, shoulder joints, back pipe roots). Joints belch, spray, rev 0...1 are empty drivers; followers flameL/flameR (0.05) switch the lit flame tongues and sprayLit (0.05) the wet chrome mouth.
parts: spiked collar with chrome mouth guard
scrap plate chest with leather straps
riveted scrap shoulder plates with spikes
twin exhaust pipes rising behind the shoulders with flame tongues
style: Rusted corten scrap armor with polished chrome trim, black leather straps and hot orange exhaust flame, original shapes only.
summary: Wasteland raider armor: spiked collar with chrome mouth guard, scrap shoulder plates and two exhaust pipes that belch flame.
